description: Pilot suite grown for the M10 Phase 1 gate run: 48 questions across next.js 16.2.9, zod 4.6.7, and serde 1.0.229 (the project's own lockfile), covering all eight task-type categories with four unanswerable questions. Refs pin the section-path segments the fixture corpus actually serves (raw breadcrumb trails, case-exact); serde's thin corpus (README only) grades through symbol pins. Every question verified PASS against the recorded corpus DB.
